511.title: Validation fixes for run 499-502: longer undo, step undo shows at once, stepper hold climbs digit by digit, one empty ingredient row
humanItems: Product form: delete a purchase option → the undo toast stays about 30 seconds and undo still works.
Recipe builder: delete a workflow step, press undo → the step shows again at once, in its place.
Cook view: from 100 g hold + → it climbs 101…109, then by tens; let go at 140, tap + five times → 145.
Recipe builder: tap the unit text of a row, press Enter → the cursor moves to the next row.
Recipe builder: with an empty ingredient row open, press the add-row button and press Enter in it →
